title: Amazon EventBridge to Amazon CloudWatch Logs
description: Create an EventBridge rule that sends events to CloudWatch Logs

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This project contains a sample AWS CDK template to create an EventBridge Rule, as well as, a CloudWatch Logs Group. The EventBridge Rule publishes matched events to CloudWatch Logs. In this example, the rule filters for specific attributes in the event before sending to the CloudWatch Logs target. Note: CDK may automatically create a Custom Resource Lambda to set certain policy configurations for CloudWatch Logs.
